d:
Dipavli ka tyohar bit chuka hai, aur gharon men jalte diyon ki roshni ab dhire-dhire chhath mahaparv ki taiyariyon men badalne lagi hai.bajaron men chhath ki kharidari shuru ho gaee hai. kahin sup aur daura sajne lage hain to kahin mitti ke chulhe aur aam ki lakriyon ki vyavastha ki ja rahi hai. iske sath hi apne ghar lautne vale pravasiyon ki bhir bhi barhne lagi hai.
